p: burden of Egypt: Read Isa 13:7.

rideth upon a swift cloud: Because the Egyptians trusted in the defence of their country, in the multitude of their idols and in the valiantness of their men the Lord shows that he will come over all their munitions in a swift cloud, and that their idols will tremble at his coming and that men's hearts will faint.
fight every one against his brother: As he caused the Ammonites, Moabites and Idumeans to kill one another, when they came to destroy the Church of God, 2Ch 20:22, Isa 49:26.
spirit of Egypt shall fail in: Meaning, their policy and wisdom.

fail from the sea: He shows that the sea and their great river Nile by which they thought themselves most sure, would not be able to defend them but that he would send the Assyrians among them, that would keep them under as slaves.
rivers far away: For the Nile ran into the sea by seven streams, as though they were many rivers.
mouth of the brooks: The Hebrew word is mouth, by which they mean the spring out of which the water gushes as out of a mouth.
mourn: The Scriptures describe the destruction of a country by the taking away of the conveniences of it, as by vines, flesh, fish and such other things by which countries are enriched.
Zoan are fools: Called also Tanes, a famous city on the Nile.
am the son of the wise: He notes the flatterers of Pharaoh: who persuaded the king that he was wise and noble, and that his house was ancient and so he flatters himself, saying I am wise.
Noph are deceived: Or Memphis, Alexandria, and now called the great Cairo.
support of its tribes: The principal upholders of it are the main cause of their destruction.
perverse spirit in the midst of: For the spirit of wisdom he has made them drunken and giddy with the spirit of error.
perform: Neither the great or the small, the strong or the weak.
to Egypt: Considering that through their opportunity the Jews did not make God their defence but put their trust in them, and were therefore now punished, they will fear least the same light on them.
speak the language of Canaan: Will make one confession of faith with the people of God, by the speech of Canaan, meaning the language in which God was then served.
swear to the LORD of hosts: Will renounce their superstitions and protest to serve God correctly.
destruction: Meaning of six cities, five would serve God, and the sixth would remain in their wickedness: and so there would be but one lost.

a pillar at its border to: There will be evident signs and tokens, that God's religion is there: which manner of speech is taken of the patriarchs and ancient time, when God has not as yet appointed the place, and full manner how he would be worshipped.
a saviour: This declares that this prophecy would be accomplished in the time of Christ.
sacrifice and oblation: By these ceremonies he comprehends the spiritual service under Christ.

Egypt to Assyria: By these two nations, which were then chief enemies of the Church, he shows that the Gentiles and the Jews would be joined together in one faith and religion, and would all be one fold under Christ their shepherd.
